facts.fact: StackAdapt advises launching seasonal marketing campaigns three to six months ahead of the season for optimal results.
facts.quote: In general, you want to launch three to six months ahead of the season for optimal results.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends using data from the previous two years when reviewing prior seasonal ad campaigns for the most relevant insights.
facts.quote: For the most relevant insights, look at data from the previous two years.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that back to school season should be a priority for brands selling clothing, accessories, and school supplies, as these are typically the leading retail categories for back to school shoppers, per a Deloitte report.
facts.quote: the back to school season should be a priority for brands that sell clothing, accessories, and school supplies because these are typically the leading retail categories for back to school shoppers.

facts.fact: StackAdapt notes that Christmas is the peak time of the year for marriage proposals and engagements.
facts.quote: Christmas is also the peak time of the year for marriage proposals and engagements.

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines seasonal marketing as any marketing that revolves around national holidays, cultural holidays, and events such as Mother's Day, back to school season, and the Super Bowl.
facts.quote: Seasonal marketing is any marketing that revolves around national holidays, cultural holidays, and events like Mother’s Day, the back to school season, and the Super Bowl.
